name: CAP baseball cap, dark blue, front
size_basis: Same drawing and size as the OCP / ABU sheets' baseball cap (hats.js: 7.6 in wide, crown 4.7 in, visor 1.9 in); no real cap was measured: head circumference taken as about 22.5 in (size 7 1/8), a 7.2 in band diameter, as for every cap drawn in hats.js. Colour = the polo shirt colour #001b52 sampled from CAPR 39-1 Figure 5.5 (5.3.7 gives no cap colour; wing and region commanders may prescribe one). The emblem is the CAP seal at 2.2 in (ESTIMATE: no emblem size in the regulation, and the polo's own seal is 2.93 in on Figure 5.5).
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left. garment_attach_center is the bottom of the cap on its centre line (the visor's lower edge on the front view, the crown's on the back view); the engine puts it on the polo sheet's hat_attach (the collar-tip line), 0.25 in seat below it, as for the sheets' own cap views (the sheets' hat_view landmark gives both boxes). device_slot is the emblem's box.
documented: the CAP baseball cap may be worn with the CAP Corporate Working Uniform; wing and region commanders may prescribe colour, unit designation and/or emblem (CAPR 39-1 5.3.7)
assumed: cap size and shape (hats.js, no real cap measured)
plain CAP seal as the default emblem, 2.2 in
